canonical_claim: Cross-replica manifest divergence is benign for correctness because single-producer publication is only an optimization; commit-time `checkEqual` is tolerant, and this rationale governs the `manifest_hash` TODO. Additionally, Single-producer non-divergence enforced via a /merge_claims lease plus manifest_hash re-keying (v2 design) was replaced in v3 by tolerant-mode cross-replica commit checking: checkPartChecksumsAndCommit -> checkEqual(..., check_uncompressed_hash_in_compressed_files=true) compares uncompressed hashes, so two replicas with identical uncompressed content but different compressed bytes both pass, yielding at worst two manifests plus two blob sets for one part name (a benign dedup-miss, not a correctness bug; both sets are GC'd when the part is superseded).

evidence.notes: `checkEqual` and `checkPartChecksumsAndCommit` are present in ordinary replicated MergeTree code; the CAS-specific `manifest_hash` and exact combined call text were not found.

canonical_claim: The `manifest_hash` field on the Keeper `/parts` znode was rejected because replication remains disk-agnostic; the manifest ID travels in-band during fetch and manifest divergence is benign. Additionally, The old CA Keeper `manifest_hash` proposal was rejected because it would couple replication to one disk implementation; fetch-by-relink learns the manifest id in-band and manifest divergence is a bounded dedup miss. Additionally, The replication `manifest_hash`-on-Keeper-znode idea B1 was rejected on 2026-07-14 because the manifest id travels in-band and replication remains disk-agnostic. Additionally, A manifest_hash-on-znode idea (B1) to detect cross-replica manifest divergence was rejected outright (2026-07-14) on layering grounds: replication code stays disk-agnostic, and CA adds no field to the Keeper part header, because a CA-specific field in ReplicatedMergeTreePartHeader would couple ReplicatedMergeTree to one disk implementation, grow the fork's upstream-contact surface, and add states to already-complex replication. Fetch-by-relink needs no Keeper field either since the manifest id travels in-band over the interserver handshake.

evidence.notes: The exact `manifest_hash` identifier was not found in the searched source, test, program, or soak directories.
